description: This file implements the client and server components for handling execution approval prompts over a Unix domain socket, including socket management, request handling, and user interface prompts for approving or denying command execution.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsPromptServer
classes.description: Singleton class managing the lifecycle of the socket server that prompts for execution approvals.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSocketServer
classes.description: Private class managing Unix socket operations, client handling, and request processing for execution approvals.

methods.name: requestDecision
methods.description: Asynchronous function to request an approval decision from the socket, with timeout handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the socket server to listen for incoming approval requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the socket server and cleans up socket files.

methods.name: handleClient
methods.description: Handles an incoming client connection, parsing requests and generating responses.

methods.name: isAllowedPeer
methods.description: Checks if the connecting peer is authorized based on UID.

methods.name: handleExecRequest
methods.description: Processes execution requests, including validation, permissions, and running commands.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes the command with given environment, directory, and timeout, returning a structured response.
